purpose: Reconciled Madueke_A↔Sabates_A modern spelling/typeset standard for rendering the modern OriginalDR (idx 108) from the basis DB.

reconciliation_basis.interpretation: 0 substantive wording divergences → the witnesses agree on content. The standard is therefore a pure normalization spec; no wording arbitration is needed. Madueke_A is authoritative for surface; the rules below resolve orthographic/typographic differences.

rules.rationale: 0 substantive divergences vs Sabates_A; Madueke_A is the reference modern edition for idx 108.
Madueke_A convention and modern orthography; 813 verses differed on this alone.

examples.sabates: And Chanaan begat Sidon his first-begotten, Hethæus,
examples.madueke: And Chanaan begat Sidon his first-begotten, Hethaeus,
examples.standard: And Chanaan begat Sidon his first-begotten, Hethaeus,

examples.sabates: and Iebusæus, and Amorrhæus, and Gergesæus.
examples.madueke: and Iebusaeus, and Amorrhaeus, and Gergesaeus.
examples.standard: and Iebusaeus, and Amorrhaeus, and Gergesaeus.

rules.rationale: The Douay tradition sets divine speech and messianic prophecy in ALL-CAPS; Madueke_A preserves this, Sabates_A title-cases it. The standard keeps the traditional majuscule (the dominant driver of the 1596 punct/space-class divergences).

examples.madueke: I will bless them that bless thee, and curse them that curse thee, and IN THEE shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
examples.sabates: I will bless them that bless thee, and curse them that curse thee, and IN Thee shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
examples.standard: I will bless them that bless thee, and curse them that curse thee, and IN THEE shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

examples.madueke: whereas he shall be into a Nation great, and very strong, and in him are TO BE BLESSED ALL THE NATIONS OF THE EARTH?
examples.sabates: whereas he shall be into a Nation great, and very strong, and in him are TO BE Blessed All The Nations of The Earth?
examples.standard: whereas he shall be into a Nation great, and very strong, and in him are TO BE BLESSED ALL THE NATIONS OF THE EARTH?

examples.madueke: and IN THY SEED SHALL BE BLESSED ALL THE NATIONS OF THE EARTH, because thou hast obeyed my voice.
examples.sabates: and IN Thy Seed Shall be Blessed All The Nations of The Earth, because thou hast obeyed my voice.
examples.standard: and IN THY SEED SHALL BE BLESSED ALL THE NATIONS OF THE EARTH, because thou hast obeyed my voice.

rules.rule: strip leading/trailing whitespace; collapse internal runs to a single space.
rules.rationale: Madueke_A HTML extraction leaves trailing spaces; normalized for stable rendering + diffing.
Where punctuation differs (no substantive impact), follow the authoritative witness.

apparatus_note: Sabates_A supplies the apparatus (arguments, verse-notes, cross-refs, annotations) and the 3-book apocryphal appendix Madueke_A omits; apparatus inclusion/placement is handled in P1.5 / P1.4, not here.
